The **_GAM(M)-MAP_** is an interactive platform for analysing uncomplicated malaria alongside climatic variability across Ghana’s former ten administrative regions. At its core, the app implements **Generalised Additive Model (GAM)** and, when residual autocorrelation is present, **Generalised Additive Mixed Model (GAMMs)**. Users can perform descriptive analysis, time‑series decomposition, seasonality assessment, and model‑based evaluation of climate–malaria relationships.


Please feel free to address any inquiries related to the use of the app via [akredw001@myuct.ac.za](mailto:akredw001@myuct.ac.za) or [akuruguedward@gmail.com](mailto:akuruguedward@gmail.com).
